formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list used as normalized; normalized one-based positions.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2); further prominent alkyl ether sulfates are reinforcing routes - Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate (9), Magnesium Laureth Sulfate (11), Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate (12), Sodium Oleth Sulfate (14), Magnesium Oleth Sulfate (15) -> strong.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: Three prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine 5, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate 6, Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate 7) plus Urea (3) and Panthenol (8); the reinforcing sulfates are late, higher-ethoxylated / magnesium oleth types that read as one mild ether-sulfate blend. Convention keeps strong; confidence lowered to moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led architecture: no cationic polymer or conditioner, no silicone, no payload lipid, no protein, no refatter. Only humectants Urea (3), Panthenol (8), Glycerin (20) and pearlizer Glycol Distearate (10).
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: Humectants and pearlizer give some feel but no substantive slip.

weightPotential.rationale: No deposition family at all; humectants are context only; strong reset.

depositionLoad.rationale: No silicone, cationic, lipid, refatter, protein or film former.

weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: there is no deposition family to leave residue; only humectants and an excluded pearlizer.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only: prominent Urea and Panthenol suggest a scalp-comfort/dry-scalp candidate (scalp_active) if positioned; lengths-care routes are absent (no conditioning support), so moisture would be nonspecific.

usageRole.rationale: Default; cleansing strong, so frequent cannot fire; alternating only with reset intent.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning unknown. CSA formula half met: prominent comfort routes Urea (3), Panthenol (8); humectant routes Urea, Panthenol. Counter-signal: cleansingStrength strong (caps targeted at moderate).
